spec.title: Digital Clock Web Application
spec.summary: A lightweight, pure UI web app that displays a real‑time digital clock with 24‑hour and 12‑hour toggle, updating every second, and styled responsively for all modern browsers.

files.name: index.html
files.purpose: Defines the complete HTML structure for the digital clock web application, including header, time display, and toggle controls, ensuring semantic tags and responsive layout.

files.name: style.css
files.purpose: Provides all CSS styles for layout, typography, color scheme, and responsive behavior of the digital clock, ensuring visual consistency across browsers.

files.name: app.js
files.purpose: Implements real-time clock functionality: retrieves system time, formats 24/12 hour display, updates every second, toggles AM/PM format, and updates DOM elements accordingly.

acceptance_criteria: The clock display element updates its time value every second without requiring page reload.
When the format toggle button is activated, the displayed time switches between 24‑hour and 12‑hour with AM/PM indicators correctly.
The displayed time matches the system time within a one‑second margin of error upon initial load and during updates.
The application loads successfully and renders a non‑empty time string in the clock container element.
All DOM elements for the clock and toggle button are present and properly styled according to the CSS definitions.
